title: Same-bug circuit breaker
description: Objective: fingerprint correlated failed approaches across siblings and hold repeated convergence until a typed fact changes or a human routes it. Deliverable: scheduler breaker modules and counterexample tests. NOT in scope: semantic memory or automatic acceptance. Hard dependencies: Deterministic context journal and Fan-in integration pipeline. Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/convergence/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Equivalent active failure fingerprints converge to one bounded hold despite prose changes.
A retry unlocks only when its authoritative predicate changes or a permitted human decision occurs.
Unrelated work remains schedulable and every hold is explainable.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.
